findings: Pinned verification metric improved from 0 to 8; the final full suite has 23 passing tests.
ED neutral gaps were computed for N=3..8 and exactly projected NQS gaps for N=3..7.
At N=7, the NQS gap differs from ED by 4.96e-13 and its 100000-sample standard error is 1.85e-9.
The N=7 L=2 multiplet has <L^2>=6, energy spread 4.44e-15, and generic-rotation equivariance error 9.43e-12.
A bounded N=4..8 linear 1/N fit gives Delta_infinity=0.1274+/-0.0048; the regression error excludes fit-model systematics.
Base challenge acceptance is complete. Bright/dark metric response and beyond-ED NQS scaling are explicitly not claimed.

config.goal: Complete Challenge #15: compute the nu=1/3 chiral-graviton neutral gap on the Haldane sphere with ED validation and a symmetry-preserving neural variational state.
